findings.body: If SIGINT reaches Forge alone while an agent is running, this finally block writes a `run end` even though the agent can remain alive. The review path wraps `_attempt`, whose output loop and wait have no interruption cleanup (`src/forge/review.py:545–566`). Both Claude paths have the same problem (`src/forge/worker.py:472–488`, `src/forge/story.py:704–713`): [CPython's Popen context manager](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.11.11/Lib/subprocess.py#L993-L1018) waits only briefly on KeyboardInterrupt and does not terminate the child. Consequently, consumers receive a completion occurrence for a running agent, and its eventual exit produces no further occurrence. Terminate and reap these children before recording the end, or retain the run until its actual exit is observed.
findings.title: Record run ends only after the child has stopped
